title: Warm Flaky Moroccan Hake Sellou
description: A pungent and flaky Moroccan dish featuring hake, perfect for a cold evening, this sellou is a traditional Moroccan recipe with a pescatarian twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the hake fillets to the bowl and coat them evenly with the mixture.
Place the coated hake fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the hake fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until they are cooked through.
While the hake is baking, toast the bread slices until they are lightly browned.
Once the hake is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the sellou, place a toasted bread slice on a plate, then add a piece of the baked hake on top of the bread.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the hake and serve immediately.
